description: Intercepts requests matching a URL pattern and fails the first N requests with an error status, then lets subsequent requests succeed. Simulates transient failures and tests retry/recovery logic. Use to answer: does the app retry after a 503 and recover when the service comes back?

failure_count.description: Number of requests to fail before allowing success (default: 3)

fallback_selector.description: CSS selector for the fallback/retry UI that should appear (e.g., '.retry-button')

http_status.description: HTTP error status code for the failing requests (default: 503)

intercept_pattern.description: Glob pattern for requests to intercept (e.g., '**/api/data**')

success_payload.description: Response body for requests after the failure window (default: {"ok":true})

url.description: URL of the page to test

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after navigation before checking state (default: 2000)

name: simulate_stateful_failure
